cohort: 400 parturients who requested analgesia at cervical dilatation <6 cm
finding: Combined spinal-epidural analgesia with subarachnoid sufentanil did not reduce the duration of stage I labor compared to epidural analgesia, but it was associated with less reduction in uterine contractility and a more rapid onset of analgesia.
mod_finding: This study found that combined spinal-epidural analgesia during labor did not reduce the duration of stage I labor compared to epidural analgesia.
